- Supports reading Salesflare data, including accounts, contacts, opportunities, tasks, and the current API user.
- Adds write actions for creating and updating accounts, contacts, opportunities, and tasks.
- Documents schema-first action execution so payloads can be validated against live connector contracts.
- Includes safety guidance for confirming write operations and handling first-time setup or connection errors.
